summary: Security Guard with 10 years of continuous experience patrolling commercial and industrial premises, monitoring access points, and responding to alarms and disturbances. Holds a current State guard card and is trained in basic first aid and emergency response.

experience.title: Security Guard
bullets: Patrol commercial premises on foot and by vehicle to detect signs of intrusion and verify that doors, windows, and gates remain secure.
Monitor and authorize entrance and departure of employees, visitors, and contractors at the main lobby and loading dock.
Answer alarms and investigate disturbances, resolving an average of 15 incidents per month and escalating accordingly.
Lock and unlock entrances, gates, and interior suites on a fixed schedule for a 4-building campus.
Write daily activity reports documenting property damage, theft attempts, unauthorized persons, and unusual occurrences.
Respond to medical emergencies by administering basic first aid and obtaining paramedic assistance when needed.
Warn persons of rule infractions and evict violators from premises while maintaining a calm, professional presence.

experience.title: Security Officer
experience.employer: a regional commercial property management company
bullets: Circulated among visitors, patrons, and employees to preserve order and protect property at a busy retail center.
Monitored a 40-camera CCTV and access control system and dispatched patrols to investigate suspicious activity.
Conducted hourly perimeter checks and secured 12 entry and exit points at closing each night.
Investigated alarm activations and documented findings in incident reports reviewed by site management.
Assisted with basic first aid for minor injuries and coordinated with paramedics on two serious medical calls.

experience.title: Security Guard
bullets: Patrolled a warehouse and distribution yard to prevent and detect signs of intrusion and protect inventory.
Verified employee and driver credentials at the gate, guarding against theft and unauthorized entry.
Wrote reports of daily activities, irregularities, and equipment or property damage for shift handoff.
Responded to fire and intrusion alarms and investigated disturbances before contacting emergency services.
Enforced site safety and conduct rules, warning violators and removing offenders when necessary.

experience.title: Security Guard
bullets: Locked and secured store doors and gates at closing and unlocked them at opening each day.
Patrolled the sales floor and stockroom to deter theft and monitor for signs of intrusion.
Monitored entrances to guard against theft and maintain a safe environment for customers and staff.
Documented theft incidents, unauthorized persons, and unusual occurrences in written reports for store management.
